description: BUS_SHELTERS is a dataset listed in Prince George's County open data portal (data.princegeorgescountymd.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Prince George's County. This point dataset represents 'The Bus' bus stop shelters in Prince George's County, Maryland. This data is captured and maintained by the Prince George's County Department of Public Works and Transportation. Coverage: Prince George's County, Maryland. The table has 11 columns. The portal shows 2026-02-23 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-princegeorgescountymd-gov-portal.
